Callback success codes disagree between the two sides: payouts registers [200,201,409] (payouts/pkg/workflow/workflow_create.go:320-325) while the WFS e2e fixture ships [200,201,408]. The caller supplies the list, so payouts' value governs the payouts path; the 408 fixture may be stale test data.

authz prod config/prod.toml:51 watchResourceGroups = [gateway, capital, platform_identity] EXCLUDES x_platform, while stage/bvt/slit/dev-serve include it. If not overridden at deploy time the prod enforcer never loads the x_platform payout policies at all. Needs a live-config check.

Two unreconciled payout policy sets exist in authz: xplatform.csv's URL-shaped resources (/v1/payouts/{id}/approve) granted to owner/admin/finance_l1-l3, and the permission-bundle roles payout_create_view / payout_approve_reject_view whose resources are bare permission names. Which one a given request is evaluated against depends on whether edge sends authorization_roles or passport_roles.
The monolith's payouts/bulk_approve path (Service.php:3539-3620) never forwards to the payouts service, while payouts/bulk does. Whether PS-owned payouts can be bulk-approved at all was not resolved.
